pages.text: Altered from $(5)Respiration$(), $(4)Hypersomnia$() causes the wearer to become extremely sleepy at night and falling completely asleep periodically, depending on level. Maximum level is $(4)III$() and it conflicts with $(5)Respiration$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: If you have difficulty falling asleep, this can be your wonder drug. Alternatively, if one wishes to get away from Phantoms but forgets to bring a bed or a sleeping sack around all the time, this can prove a viable alternative. Do be warned, however, that slumber may take you at inopportune times, such as in the middle of combat.
